chunks: Muslims are bound by their agreements.

key_terms.اَلْمُسْلِمُونَ: The Muslims; those addressed as morally and legally bound.
key_terms.شُرُوطِهِمْ: Their conditions, stipulations, or agreed terms.

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "Muslims are bound by their agreements" mean?
ai.summary: This prophetic tradition establishes that Muslims are obligated to honor the conditions and agreements they undertake. It is a foundational principle in Islamic jurisprudence for contracts, commitments, and mutual obligations.
